title: 第二十六章 本心难持第二十七章 见帝不拜者
slug: 自完美世界开始第2369章唐昊
content_zh:
东华山，少林寺。
自从千年前少林祖师达摩一苇渡江东渡中土，创立少林寺，传下七十二绝技。少林自此兴久不衰，哪怕世间王朝更迭，少林也能度过劫难。
这日，衣着朴素的车夫赶着一辆贵气暗藏的古拙马车，驶上了少林。
“阿弥陀佛。”一位黄衣守山僧人念了句佛号，开口道：“这位施主请停下，上山道路崎岖坎坷，马车难行，若想礼佛，请施主自行走上山门。”
衣着朴素的王柯停下勒马停车，转身看向车厢内恭敬的询问道：“主上，该要如何？”
要是认识王柯的武林人士看到这一幕，必然会觉得出现了幻觉，高高在上的大宗师竟然如同奴仆。
“那便下车吧。”带着淡淡笑意的话语从车厢内传出，紧接着，守山僧人便见一位头挽发髻，眼神深邃，英俊的面容展露温和笑意的玄袍道人，背负一刀一剑从撩开车帘走出，浑身上下透出一种说不出的气质，让人眼前一亮，真真一位得道真人。
这几日里尝尽天下美食，心情甚是愉悦。林阳微笑道：“有劳这位法师带路。”
“施主，请。”守山僧人转身带路上山，王柯驾着马车在另外的僧人引领下，将马车停放好。
林阳走在山路上眼神微微恍惚，这方世界的少林寺布局和朵儿察世界少林寺，几乎一模一样。还记得当初自己的拳脚功夫惨不忍睹，凭着神力活脱脱一个乱拳打死老师傅的典型人物，现在不过半年，就成为了力量与技巧并存的高手。
不对，应该是只用了几个呼吸。
想到此处，他不禁的洒然一笑。
也亏得王柯紧跟身后，看不见他的表情，要不又得胡乱猜测。
不到片刻，林阳二人来到了宽阔的广场。另一个世界他曾在此用勉强引动狻猊宝术灭杀朵儿察，奠定了直通人榜第一的基石。林阳猜测过，除了不知道存不存在的掌握着法身招式，执掌宝兵的理论级半步外景之外，恐怕只有真正的外景才能带给他历练点。
修炼两门绝世神功，将数门外景绝学修炼到随心所欲，还执掌中品宝兵，实在是太过可怕。林阳都曾怀疑，人榜后面所有人加起来也敌不过他。
走进大雄宝殿，入眼便是金碧辉煌，佛祖拈花微笑，木鱼声不绝于耳，禅音阵阵。
从王柯手中取来三根金丝缭绕的檀木香，林阳恭恭敬敬的鞠躬，上香。
希望佛祖保佑我能寻到《如来神掌》总纲。
林阳平心静气，内心一片空灵。他也知道以此界佛祖目前与诸天万界隔离的状态，不可能保佑他，这次也只是心理安慰罢了。
从前他也不懂为何上香从来都是三根，一直到拜入玄天宗才略有了解。

道教三根香代表着三清祖师，而在佛教则是象征着佛、法、僧三者，民间的三根，代表了天、地、人。
玄天宗是天帝道统，虽着道士装扮，却不信奉三清。
香上完。
林阳看向身穿红色袈裟，慈眉善目，自始至终闭眼念经的方丈。他开口想说点什么，最终还是转身离去。
content_en:
Donghua Mountain, Shaolin Temple.
Since Bodhidharma, the founder of Shaolin, crossed the Yangtze River to China thousands of years ago and established the Shaolin Temple, he has passed down seventy-two unique skills. Shaolin has been prospering ever since. Even if dynasties change in the world, Shaolin can survive the disaster.
On this day, a plainly dressed coachman drove an ancient carriage with hidden nobility to Shaolin.
"Amitabha." A monk in yellow clothes guarding the mountain recited the Buddha's name and said, "This donor, please stop. The road up the mountain is rugged and bumpy, making it difficult for carriages to travel. If you want to worship the Buddha, please go up to the mountain gate yourself."
Wang Ke, who was plainly dressed, stopped, reined in his horse, turned around, looked into the carriage and asked respectfully: "My lord, what should I do?"
If people in the martial arts world who know Wang Ke see this scene, they will definitely feel that they are hallucinating. The aloof grand master is like a slave.
"Then get out of the car." Words with a faint smile came from the carriage. Then, the monk guarding the mountain saw a Taoist priest in Xuanpao with a bun on his head, deep eyes, and a gentle smile on his handsome face. He walked out from the car curtain with a sword on his back. There was an indescribable temperament in his whole body, which made people shine. He was really a Taoist man.
In the past few days, I have tasted all kinds of delicious food from all over the world, and I feel very happy. Lin Yang smiled and said, "I'd like this mage to lead the way."
"Donor, please." The monk guarding the mountain turned around and led the way up the mountain. Wang Ke drove the carriage and parked it under the guidance of other monks.
Lin Yang's eyes were in a trance as he walked on the mountain road. The layout of the Shaolin Temple in this world is almost exactly the same as that of the Shaolin Temple in the Doercha world. I still remember that at the beginning, my boxing and kicking skills were terrible. With my supernatural power, I looked like a typical person who beat the old master to death with random punches. Now, in less than half a year, I have become a master of both strength and skill.
No, it should have only taken a few breaths.
Thinking of this, he couldn't help but smile.
Fortunately, Wang Ke followed closely behind him and couldn't see his expression, otherwise he would have to make random guesses.
In less than a moment, Lin Yang and the two arrived at the wide square. In another world, he had used the Suani Treasure Technique to kill Doercha here, laying the foundation for his direct path to the top of the list. Lin Yang had guessed that apart from the theoretical half-step exterior scenes of mastering the moves of the Dharmakaya and commanding treasure weapons, I am afraid that only real exterior scenes can give him experience points.
It is really terrifying to practice two peerless magical skills, master several outdoor skills to the point where you can do whatever you want, and also be in charge of a middle-grade treasure weapon. Lin Yang once suspected that all the people at the end of the list could not defeat him.
When you walk into the Main Hall, you will see the splendor of gold and jade green, Buddha holding flowers and smiling, the sound of wooden fish and the sound of Zen are endless.
Taking three golden sticks of sandalwood incense from Wang Ke's hand, Lin Yang bowed respectfully and offered the incense.
I hope that the Buddha will bless me to find the general outline of "Tathagata Divine Palm".
Lin Yangping was calm and empty inside. He also knew that the Buddha in this world was currently isolated from all the heavens and worlds, and it was impossible to protect him. This time it was just psychological comfort.
In the past, he didn't understand why there were always three incense sticks. He didn't understand it until he became a member of the Xuantian Sect.
The three incense sticks in Taoism represent the founders of the Three Purities, while in Buddhism they symbolize the Buddha, the Dharma, and the Sangha. The three incense sticks among the people represent heaven, earth, and man.
The Xuantian Sect is the lineage of the Emperor of Heaven. Although they dress up as Taoists, they do not believe in the Three Pure Ones.
The incense is finished.
Lin Yang looked at the abbot who was wearing a red cassock, had kind eyes and closed his eyes the entire time. He opened his mouth to say something, but finally turned and left.
